byte_reproducibility.evidence: consecutive componentize-py builds (even with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0) yield differing sha256 and size

security_note: a benign sync componentize-py Python component validated and ran clean in the isolated worker under the current GHSA-32h6 HOLD posture (no native abort).
